summary: Frontend-only re-verification of the reported black/blank screen issue in both LOGGED-OUT and LOGGED-IN (admin) states. Issue does NOT reproduce. All acceptance criteria from the review request pass: fresh load renders home-page + main-navbar + site-footer with hero copy 'FLIP. FLY. FIND YOUR GREATNESS.' (verified via screenshot); admin login succeeds and redirects to /admin; while authenticated the homepage renders with nav-user-menu visible; /dashboard renders parent-dashboard and /admin renders admin-dashboard; all 11 header-linked pages (about, preschool, recreational, competitive, cheer, college-recruits, calendar, camps, special-events, birthday-parties, contact) render their <slug>-page testid with navbar; logout returns the site to logged-out state with home still rendering. The ErrorBoundary recovery UI (data-testid='error-reload-btn') was NEVER triggered on any route/state.
critical_code_review_comments: ErrorBoundary in /app/frontend/src/components/common/ErrorBoundary.jsx is correctly wrapping <App/> in index.js and did not fire during any of the 15+ navigation events tested — safety net is in place but nothing crashes to trigger it.

Hero copy is split across span/color-highlighted nodes ('FIND' is a separate lime span), so `page.locator("text=FLIP. FLY. FIND YOUR GREATNESS.")` returns 0 as a strict text match; visually confirmed via screenshot. Not a bug — just a note for future test authors: assert against a partial substring or an element containing the phrase.
Console noise: the only [error] entries are the expected 401s from GET /api/auth/me (documented as expected in the review request). No pageerror events were captured across the whole run.

External-only failed requests: (a) fonts.googleapis.com/css?family=Google+Sans+Text (Google Maps embed sub-request on /contact) — net::ERR_ABORTED, environment/CSP, non-blocking; (b) POSTs to /cdn-cgi/rum — Cloudflare RUM beacon, infrastructure, not the app. Neither affects rendering.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — 15/15 route+state checks pass, 0 ErrorBoundary triggers, 0 pageerrors

test_credentials: admin@usgoldgym.com / GymAdmin2026! — login succeeded, redirected to /admin, nav-user-menu rendered, /dashboard + /admin both loaded with expected testids.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The 'black/blank screen' report did NOT reproduce in this iteration under either logged-out or logged-in-as-admin sessions. ErrorBoundary is now wired in index.js as a safety net (data-testid='error-reload-btn'); it never fires under normal flows. If the user reports it again, likely causes to check are (1) truly stale cached bundle in the user's browser (Ctrl+Shift+R / cleared SW), or (2) a component-level render crash that would now surface the ErrorBoundary reload UI — screenshot that UI and read backend logs + browser console for the underlying error. The 401 on /api/auth/me when logged out is expected. Programs/Events header items live inside Radix dropdowns (nav-programs-trigger / nav-events-trigger) — direct URL nav to sub-routes works fine, which is what we tested.
rca of the issue: The reported black screen could not be reproduced. Automated coverage of both anonymous and admin-authenticated flows across 14 routes shows 100% render success with no fatal JS errors, no failed chunk loads, and no ErrorBoundary triggers. Root cause of the user's original observation is most consistent with the hypothesis stated in the request: a stale JS bundle cached in the user's browser prior to the frontend restart. The added ErrorBoundary now guarantees that any future render crash will show a recovery UI with data-testid='error-reload-btn' instead of a blank page, so this class of bug becomes self-diagnosing on the next report.
